تغتالوا (form VIII)
# تَغْتَالُوا (taḡtālū) /taɣ.taː.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَالَ (iḡtāla)
# تُغْتَالُوا (tuḡtālū) /tuɣ.taː.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَالَ (iḡtāla)
